using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class AofTaskStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_LogsError_WhenStartAddressBeforeTruncatedUntilAndAllowDataLossIsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 1000; // Set via reflection or make internal setter for test

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks("replica1", 500); // startAddress < TruncatedUntil

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("failed to add tasks for AOF sync") && v.ToString().Contains("500") && v.ToString().Contains("1000")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_DoesNotLogError_WhenStartAddressBeforeTruncatedUntilButAllowDataLossIsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(true);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 1000;

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks("replica1", 500);

            // Assert - no error log call
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Never);

            // Should succeed when AllowDataLoss=true
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_LogsErrorWithCorrectMessageFormat()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 2000L;

            // Act
            store.TryAddReplicationTasks("node-123", 1500L);

            // Assert specific message format from line 271
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => 
                        v.ToString().Contains("TryAddReplicationTasks") &&
                        v.ToString().Contains("failed to add tasks for AOF sync 1500 2000")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;

namespace Garnet.cluster

    public class AofTaskStoreLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LoggerExtensions_LogError_IsCalled_WhenStartAddressBeforeTruncatedUntilAndAllowDataLossIsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Error)).Returns(true);
            
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(new Mock<ClusterManager>().Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions).Returns(new Mock<ServerOptions>().Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager).Returns(new Mock<ReplicationManager>().Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.ClusterUsername).Returns("user");
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.ClusterPassword).Returns("pass");
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(new Mock<StoreWrapper>().Object);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Use reflection to set internal state to trigger the LogError path at line 271
            SetPrivateField(store, "TruncatedUntil", 1000L);
            SetPrivateField(store, "_disposed", false);

            // Create minimal ReplicaSyncSession array to pass to TryAddReplicationTasks
            var replicaSyncSessions = new ReplicaSyncSession[0];

            // Act
            var result = InvokeTryAddReplicationTasks(store, replicaSyncSessions, 500L);

            // Assert - Verify LogError extension was called with correct message format from line 271
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                        v?.ToString().Contains("TryAddReplicationTasks failed to add tasks for AOF sync 500 1000") == true),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.False(result);
        }

        private static bool InvokeTryAddReplicationTasks(AofTaskStore store, ReplicaSyncSession[] replicaSyncSessions, long startAddress)
        {
            return (bool)typeof(AofTaskStore)
                .GetMethod("TryAddReplicationTasks", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .Invoke(store, new object[] { replicaSyncSessions, startAddress })!;
        }

        private static void SetPrivateField(object target, string fieldName, object value)
        {
            var field = target.GetType().GetField(fieldName, BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            field?.SetValue(target, value);
        }
    }
